English: Pasture Patch
A small, makeshift grazing area for the first few herds, demarcated with rope and rough earthworks. Provides the foundation for expanding horse husbandry.
Tethered Herd
A larger, loosely organized group of horses, tethered with posts and basic fencing, watched by young herders. Expands the tribes ability to maintain and grow horse populations.
Nomad Corral
A sturdy, mobile corral of wooden stakes and woven branches, allowing for the safe holding and breeding of larger horse herds during seasonal migrations.
Enclosed Grazing Field
A well-fenced grazing enclosure, sometimes with watchtowers and guarded approaches, keeping the herds secure and allowing selective breeding and improved supply logistics.
Horse Training Yard
A specialized yard with circular tracks, trainers, and makeshift stables for the breaking and preparation of warhorses. Improves both horde effectiveness and mobility.
Breeders Pen
Dedicated, guarded enclosures for the best breeding stock, enabling the selection of superior horses and increased herd growth for the horde.
Stallion Enclosure
Robust pens for prized stallions, guarded and cared for by skilled handlers, ensuring a steady supply of elite warhorses and increasing the hordes prestige.
Mare Sanctuary
A protected grazing haven for the most fertile mares, overseen by the clans elders. Vast and well-stocked, it greatly expands herd growth and unity.
Champion Stables
Grand stables for the hordes legendary horses, with skilled trainers and ceremonial paddocks. An unmatched symbol of prestige and martial readiness.
River Nomad Equestrian Domain
An immense, legendary domain encompassing open pastures, training arenas, and sacred breeding grounds—renowned across the river nomad lands for unrivaled horse mastery.
